fusions.name: Mouldered Wound
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Bloom of Rot
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes a burst of spores that deals 26 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and is [Diseased], so healing does less for it, for 8 seconds. [Diseased] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Digesting Rot
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Threaded Through
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
